description: NPg Network Development Plan is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Here you can view our Network Development Plan (NDP) Methodology, Network Development Report (NDR) and Network Headroom Report (NHR) as attachments below. The purpose of our NDR is to transparently communicate our investment decisions and future network intervention plans to stakeholders, and to highlight areas where Flexibility Services may be required. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Network Development Plan (NDP), Flexibility, Forecast, Methodology, Network Capacity and Utilisation, Network Reinforcement and Interventions. The portal shows 2024-03-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
